preconditions.description: The number of rows n must be between 1 and 5 inclusive.
The number of columns m must be between 1 and 20 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in a)
preconditions.description: The list a must contain exactly n integers representing the number of contiguous black segments in each row.

preconditions.expression: len(b) == m and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in b)
preconditions.description: The list b must contain exactly m integers representing the number of contiguous black segments in each column.

postconditions.description: The output must consist of exactly n lines.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line) == m for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each line in the output must contain exactly m characters.

postconditions.expression: all(line.count('*') == sum(1 for x in a if x > 0) for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: The number of black cells in each row must match the specified number of contiguous black segments.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(1 for line in stdout.splitlines() if line[i] == '*') == sum(1 for x in b if x > 0) for i in range(m))
postconditions.description: The number of black cells in each column must match the specified number of contiguous black segments.
